hard_max_reason: Absolute monthly limit no phase ceiling may pass: just above the largest proposed phase ($53, the learner mini SOC). Raising it is its own reviewed edit.

stage-0.reason: The working ceiling set in the foundation design; stage 0 itself costs $0.

stage-1.reason: Two Twingate connector droplets at $6 each, $12 in all, approved under the original $30 working ceiling.

stage-2.reason: Maintainer approval 2026-10-30: "yes $30 should be fine", answering: make stage-2 the current phase at its planned $30 ceiling. Stage 2 adds $0 to the cloud bill in the reference environment (logs go to the on-prem SIEM).

stage-3.reason: Proposed in the stage design: needs $29 (connectors $12, s-1vcpu-2gb droplet $12, Spaces bucket $5); the ceiling stays at $30 and leaves $1. No bridge is costed: etke.cc hosts the Discord-to-Matrix bridge (2026-10-22, #254), and recomputing without it leaves $29 unchanged. Needs the maintainer's approval before becoming current.

stage-4.reason: Proposed in the stage design: Grafana runs on-prem and adds $0 to the cloud bill, so the ceiling stays equal. Needs the maintainer's approval before becoming current.

aws-twin.reason: Proposed: the AWS twin of stage 1 is $20.84 and is applied only while the DigitalOcean connectors are torn down, so it fits under $30 alone. Needs the maintainer's approval before becoming current.

edge.reason: Placeholder, not costed: the public edge (DMZ) design has no price yet. $35 is the floor, stage 3's $29 plus one $6 droplet. The edge design sets the real number; needs the maintainer's approval before becoming current.

second-site.reason: Proposed: a second DigitalOcean site adds two more $6 connectors, +$12, to stage 3's $29, $41. Needs the maintainer's approval before becoming current.

learner-soc.reason: Proposed: a learner's own cloud mini SOC at the largest single-droplet option, $24, on top of stage 3's $29. Not part of the reference environment; needs the maintainer's approval before becoming current.
